d: Tirhut snatak nirvachan kshetr se bhari maton se jitkar emaelsi bane banshidhar brajvasi ki bhajpa men shamil hone ki khabron par saspens gahra gaya hai. jahan pahle khabren aaeen ki unhonne bhajpa ka daman tham liya hai, vahin ab unke tikhe yu-tarn se siyasi halchal barh gaee hai. unhonne apni rajnitik sthiti ko lekar kya saphaee di hai, dekhie is vishesh riport men.
